study: Connors RSI-2 'green' as a 1-minute entry: close above its 200-bar average, below its 5-bar average, RSI-2 under 10 (the green segments of the operator's CM_RSI_2_Strategy_Lower panel; ai_entry_watch.live_cm_rsi 'green'), fired from completed bars on every board name, against a random later minute of the same name.
registered_at: 2026-10-14 ~14:20 ET, before any return of this rule was computed on market data.
origin: Operator 2026-10-14 (chart: green at the low of a pullback, price bounced after). Larry Connors' published rule (daily bars); the desk computes it on 1-minute bars but never graded it as an entry. It is an outside rule, not suggested by these sessions, so the 26 cached sessions grade it.
prior: LOW. RSI < 30 / RSI crosses matched random minutes over 60 days and were worse inside the up-day morning (rsi-and-macd-gap-add-nothing); AGY's RSI-2 turn FAILED 10/13; limit-below (10/14) found that dips after a signal keep falling. The green rule differs: it requires an uptrend (SMA200) and a pullback (below SMA5).
rule: early_entry_honest.con_live_series, the live shape: RAW IEX 1-minute bars (no gap fill), with the last 220 IEX bars of earlier sessions (10 calendar days back, fetched after the 10/14 close by --fetch-prior) prepended for warm-up, as ai_entry_watch.symbol_ohlc loads them; RSI-2 (Wilder, alpha 1/2) and both averages over the joined series: close > SMA(200) and close < SMA(5) and RSI-2 < 10; False when any close in the 200-bar window is missing. Onset (flag true, previous bar false), on the board, 09:50-15:30, 15-minute refractory per name (early_entry_honest.fires). A name-day with no prior bars warms up within the session (counted as CON_no_prior_bars).
fill_markout_control_cost_statistic_spli: Identical to early_entry_mid_rsi2_prereg.json: entry at the SIP open of the next minute, exit at the SIP close 9 minutes after the entry bar (10-minute hold); control = random LATER minute of the same name (entry+1..+60, seed sha256(symbol|day|entry_minute|CON|early-honest-v1)); 10 bp round trip on both; lift = rule net - control net, day-equal mean, day-clustered t; half A ends 2026-09-24.
calibration: Null run on the synthetic walk (30 days x 15 names, early_entry_honest_null.py --study connors; synthetic days have no prior bars, so CON warms up in-session): lift +1.1 / -1.5 bp, |t| <= 0.49. No method bias.
pass: Each half PASS = day-equal lift >= +5 bp with day-clustered t >= 2.0, day-equal net > 0, >= 100 scored signals, >= 6 days. CON is PASS only if both halves PASS; FAIL if either FAILs; else UNDERPOWERED (not evidence either way).
information_only: cross control (another board name, same minute), close entry, 20 bp cost
no_retuning: 200 / 5 / 10, the window, refractory, hold, cost and split are fixed. RSI-2 < 5, other averages or holds are a new prereg.
if_pass: Provisional: repeat on >= 10 forward sessions after 2026-10-14 with the same bar, then a result-skeptic review of the positive, before any arm change.
if_fail: The completed-bar 1-minute Connors green is closed as an entry on the free feed.
script: tools/studies/early_entry_honest.py --study connors (--score only after a result-skeptic READY); tests/test_early_entry_honest.py::test_connors_green_needs_uptrend_pullback_and_oversold
declared_deviations: Live fires intrabar on the live print with the stream overlay; the harness uses completed 1-minute bars (entry at the next minute's SIP open).
Live symbol_ohlc may include the Finnhub stream overlay; the harness uses Alpaca IEX bars only.
multiplicity: 6th entry rule graded on these same 26 sessions (PRE, IGN, MID, RSI2T, limit-below primary, CON; SQ information only). The operator's chart that prompted it is from 2026-10-14, outside the cache (ends 10-13). 'Outside rule' stands only together with the forward test in if_pass.
amended: 2026-10-14 before any score, after result-skeptic round 1 FIX FIRST: live-shaped raw-bar series with prior-session warm-up (the grid version could not fire before ~12:49), missing-close guard, declared deviations, multiplicity and chart date.
